claims.claim: GivEnergy Hybrid Gen3 LV inverter firmware (ARM A316 and DSP D316 images)
Matching C/assembly decompilation rebuilt with the original vendor compiler and linker toolchains, then compared byte-for-byte with the target images.

The public v1.0.0 release was published 2026-10-16. The README reports byte-identical rebuilds of both images: 99.0% of A316 image bytes and 74.1% of D316 words come from recovered source; the remaining image content is vendor libraries, a region table, and linker padding. The maintainer says the work has only been tested as a rebuild, not as firmware to flash.

Public C/assembly source, analysis notes, build tools, and comparison gates; no original firmware images are included. The repository MIT license covers the author’s tooling, documentation, configuration, and annotations, while reproduced GivEnergy and third-party code retain their original rights.

GivEnergy Hybrid Gen3 LV inverter: STM32F105/107 ARM A316 and TMS320F2806x DSP D316. Matching builds were verified on macOS Apple Silicon with Wine and the native macOS TI object tools; the maintainer says Linux with Wine should work but has not tried it.
